tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description: Run all existing tests in the project to verify they pass. The test files are: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Login.test.tsx, src/components/Signup.test.tsx, src/auth/credentialStore.test.ts. Run the full suite with `npx vitest run` from the project root. Also run `npx tsc --noEmit` to verify TypeScript compiles without errors. Report any failing tests or type errors.
